name: retrieval-practice-generator
description: Generate retrieval practice questions at varied difficulty levels for a topic or concept. Use when creating quiz starters, revision activities, or low-stakes testing materials.
evidence_sources: Roediger & Butler (2011) — The critical role of retrieval practice in long-term retention
Karpicke & Roediger (2008) — The critical importance of retrieval for learning
Rowland (2014) — Meta-analysis: the effect of testing versus restudy on retention (effect size 0.50)
Agarwal et al. (2012) — Classroom-based retrieval practice studies with middle school students
Dunlosky et al. (2013) — Practice testing rated as high-utility learning strategy

required.description: The specific concept or skill students need to retrieve
Age/year group and approximate prior knowledge level

optional.description: From context engine: individual language levels, prior knowledge gaps
From context engine: school's assessment framework or curriculum standard
How long ago students first encountered this material
Specific misconceptions already observed in this cohort

fields.description: List of retrieval questions, each with question text, retrieval type label (free recall / cued recall / recognition), and difficulty estimate
When to use these questions relative to original learning
Key points for correct answers and common errors to watch for
Brief suggested implementation script (how to run the retrieval activity)
